newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BEDZIN TO INVEST $200 MLN, SEEK LISTING.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BEDZIN TO INVEST $200 MLN, SEEK LISTING.

text.p: Polish power station Bedzin SA, which signed a cooperation deal with German STEAG AG, plans to invest up to $200 million over six years and enter the Warsaw bourse around the end of this year, a Bedzin official said on Wednesday.
"In the next six years we plan investment of $200 million, part of it likely to come from STEAG, with whom we have signed a cooperation contract," Bedzin marketing head Jaroslaw Wrobel told Reuters.
"In September we plan to submit a prospectus to the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) and enter the Warsaw bourse at the turn of 1997 and 1998," Wrobel said.
Wrobel said that under the two-year deal the firms would form joint ventures in power-engineering in the southern industrial regions of Zaglebie Dabrowskie and upper Silesia.
He also said the company was considering selling existing series A shares and a new series B issue which would help finance its investment programme.
